Pree, the ticket is **#88412**. Tobias posted it here in #central-team on 2025-07-02. It was the Tier 2 support escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing on the BOL barcode scan at Tansleigh Packaging.

Tobias first wrote "TP", which you took for Tansley Parcel. He and Hollis then confirmed it was **Tansleigh Packaging**, so check the account name on the slide. The night shift lead said the scanner app hung whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest.

I found this only in the channel thread. I couldn't see the ticket record itself, so I can't confirm its final status or resolution. If the deck needs those, check them in the support system.
